Question 1 of 3: A word for inflammation of the throat. The words ends in -itis , select the beginning. □ ot □ tonsil □ encephal □ rhin □ neur □ pharyng Question 1 answer is pharyng for pharyngitis . Question 2 of 3: A word for disease of the nerves. The word begins with neuro- , select the ending. □ itis □ scopy □ logy □ pathy □ megaly □ gram Question 2 answer is pathy for neuropathy . Question 3 of 3: The word for a person working with the nerves. The word ends in -ologist , select the beginning. □ ophthal □ neur □ cardi □ mamm □ colon □ gastr Question 3 answer is neur for neurologist . Great job!
